messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Rattle can't install XML on Ubuntu 10.01
parts:
Hi Tom,

The key is the last message before the ERROR: 

"Cannot find xml2-config"

You need to install the appropriate Ubuntu package to compile some of this stuff:

$ wajig whichpkg xml2-config
...
/usr/bin/xml2-config                                        libxml2-dev      
...

So either

$ wajig install libxml2-dev

or if you haven't installed wajig:

$ sudo apt-get install libxm20dev

Hope that helps...

Regards,
Graham
